description: Find Trakis checks by a word or a problem, when you do not know the check's code. Searches titles, what each check looks at, why it matters and where the problem usually comes from. Returns up to 10 checks, best matches first.

query.description: A word or short phrase, e.g. "canonical", "robots.txt", "duplicate title", "structured data".
